_documentation.purpose: Fast-follow control experiment: repeat the demonstrated 10 nm optical transport while allowing the beam to keep its 15 nm lead as vortex velocity approaches 1.2 km/s.
_documentation.relies_on: Uses the existing uniform solver through configs/simulations/nbn_optical_vortex_large_unpinned.json. It is deliberately separate from the experimental nested-mesh representation until two-level evolution is validated.
_documentation.interpretation: Changes only beam-following bandwidth relative to the successful detailed run: power, spot, thermal thresholds and target remain controls. This isolates whether collapse of beam-vortex separation limited late velocity.

fields.simulation_config: Enlarged 150 nm uniform-grid reference with consistent 13 K bath and contacts.
fields.applied_field_T: Uniform perpendicular field used to retain one +1 vortex.
fields.seed_position_m: Physical seed used to find the vortex after dark preparation.
fields.target.displacement_m: Requested displacement from the prepared center; [0,5e-9] requests 5 nm in +y.
fields.target.tolerance_nm: Euclidean target radius that counts as successful arrival.
fields.laser.absorbed_power_W: Absorbed power while the laser is on. The surrounding hotspot may exceed Tc in this experiment.
fields.laser.offset_m: Beam position relative to the tracked vortex; positive y produces the intended forward gradient.
fields.pinning.enabled: Optional Gaussian pinning landscape; false isolates optical and boundary behavior.
fields.thermal_control.sensor: vortex makes hysteresis respond to interpolated electron temperature at the tracked core rather than the global maximum.
fields.thermal_control.switch_off_K: Turn the laser off as the local vortex temperature approaches material Tc=15.5 K.
fields.thermal_control.restart_below_K: Restart after the vortex has cooled below this lower threshold.
fields.thermal_control.hard_stop_K: Null permits remote parts of the hotspot to exceed Tc; topology loss and solver failure remain stop conditions.
fields.thermal_control.minimum_dwell_steps: Minimum time between switching decisions to prevent chatter.
fields.timing.sample_every: Steps between flushed scalar and force-proxy diagnostics.
fields.timing.stall_window_steps: Progress window used to detect an unproductive control loop.
fields.timing.minimum_progress_per_window_nm: Minimum net targetward progress per window.
fields.timing.max_wall_hours: Wall-clock limit for one invocation; resume can continue.
fields.output.field_snapshot_every: Steps between atomic compressed temperature, phonon, psi, vortex and beam frames used for a field GIF.
